topic.name: 中国与世界
topic.description: 关注中国经济、外交、安全、产业链与海外利益

overview: 今日专题“中国与世界”。共筛选 23 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

items.title: Paul Keating says Aukus locking Australia into a US war against China, which it would ‘certainly lose’
items.summary: Former prime minister says US would ‘scuttle itself back to San Diego’, leaving Australia to deal with retribution from China Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our new political email, free app or daily news podcast Aukus critic Paul Keating has said the submarine deal is locking Australia in to any future US conflict with China – “a war America would certainly lose” – and making Australia a target for retribution. The former prime minister seized on comments reported out of Washington this week from Republican congressman Michael McCaul – a China hawk and co-chair of the Congressional Friends of Australia caucus – who said “Australia is a target” for enemies of the US already. However, McCaul argued that greater integration with the US military would better protect Australia rather than leaving it more vulnerable. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 保罗·基廷称“奥库斯”将澳大利亚锁定在必败的对华战争中
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚前总理保罗·基廷批评“奥库斯”潜艇协议，认为这使澳大利亚卷入美国与中国的潜在冲突，并使其成为报复目标。他警告称美国若战败将撤回本土，留下澳大利亚独自面对后果。
items.whyImportant: 此言论反映了澳大利亚国内对于深度参与美中地缘政治竞争所带来的安全风险的激烈辩论。

items.title: Can the new Pinglu Canal become China’s Yangtze of the southwest?
items.summary: The opening of China’s first new river-to-sea canal since 1949 – which will boost trade links with Southeast Asia – could transform the economy of the country’s landlocked southwestern interior in ways comparable to the Yangtze’s role in Shanghai’s rise, according to its operator. The 134.2km (83.4 mile) Pinglu Canal, which opened on Wednesday, links a major tributary of the Pearl River in the southern Guangxi Zhuang autonomous region with the Gulf of Tonkin, known as the Beibu Gulf in China,...
items.titleZh: 平陆运河能否成为中国西南部的“长江”？
items.summaryZh: 中国新开通的平陆运河连接了珠江支流与北部湾，旨在促进与东南亚的贸易往来。运营方认为，该运河有望像长江带动上海崛起一样，彻底改变中国内陆西南地区的经济格局。
items.whyImportant: 平陆运河的开通标志着中国在优化内陆水运物流与区域经济协同发展方面迈出重要一步。

items.title: ByteDance spin-off Anew Labs raises US$290m as AI drug developers enjoy fundraising boom
items.summary: China is seeing a fresh fundraising boom for artificial intelligence-powered drug developers, with start-ups including a ByteDance spin-off raising hundreds of millions of dollars this week as investors rush to back domestic challengers to Anthropic and Isomorphic Labs. Anew Labs, a Shanghai-based AI drug discovery firm and former unit of Chinese tech giant ByteDance, has raised US$290 million at a valuation of US$1.5 billion, according to an informed source. Investors included prominent venture...
items.titleZh: 字节跳动分拆公司Anew Labs融资2.9亿美元，AI药物研发领域掀起融资热潮
items.summaryZh: 中国AI药物研发初创企业近期融资活跃，字节跳动旗下的Anew Labs以15亿美元估值筹集了2.9亿美元。投资者正积极布局，以支持本土企业挑战国际领先的AI制药公司。
items.whyImportant: 这显示了资本市场对中国AI驱动药物研发领域的信心，以及该行业在全球竞争中的快速崛起。

items.title: Hongkongers pay tribute to late leader Tung Chee-hwa at community halls
items.summary: Some residents have started paying tribute to Hong Kong’s first chief executive Tung Chee-hwa on Friday morning, bringing flowers and writing heartfelt messages in condolence books placed at three community halls across the city. The condolence signing is arranged for the public a day ahead of Tung’s vigil on Saturday, followed by a state funeral on Sunday. “Chief Executive Tung, you devoted yourself selflessly so that Hong Kong could make a smooth transition. Hong Kong people will remember you...
items.titleZh: 香港市民在社区会堂悼念前特首董建华
items.summaryZh: 香港市民周五前往各区社区会堂，通过献花和留言悼念首任行政长官董建华。官方安排了悼念册供公众签署，以纪念其为香港平稳过渡所作的贡献。
items.whyImportant: 此举体现了香港社会对首任特首历史地位的缅怀与尊重。

items.title: China publicly names officials in ‘unprecedented’ hidden-debt crackdown. Can it work?
items.summary: A recently issued official circular has put China’s long-running problem with hidden local government debt back in the spotlight. Earlier this month, the Ministry of Finance (MoF) and the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection (CCDI) jointly outlined six typical cases spanning six provinces where local authorities had fallen short of targets to resolve unrecorded liabilities. “For hidden-debt penalty announcements, it is unprecedented to have the CCDI alongside the MoF,” said Qiao Yide,...
items.titleZh: 中国公开点名官员以打击隐性债务，此举能否奏效？
items.summaryZh: 中国财政部与中纪委联合发布通报，点名批评六省份在化解隐性债务方面未达标。这是官方首次联合行动，旨在通过纪律审查强化对地方政府债务的监管。
items.whyImportant: 此次联合行动显示了中央政府化解地方债务风险、维护金融稳定的决心。

items.title: Ngong Ping 360 cable car opens in Hong Kong after typhoon delay - SCMP archive
items.summary: This article was first published on September 18, 2006. Breezy launch is on the cards By Dennis Eng The Ngong Ping 360 cable car will open today in one of the windiest months of the year, according to the Hong Kong Observatory. Windy conditions with gusts reaching 90km/h occur on 5.5 days for a total of 52 hours in September on average, according to measurements taken at Ngong Ping between 2002 and last year. June, July and August are typically the windiest months. The Observatory’s forecast...
items.titleZh: 香港昂坪360缆车在台风延误后开通 - 南华早报存档
items.summaryZh: 本文回顾了2006年9月18日昂坪360缆车的开通情况。尽管当时正值多风季节，天文台数据显示九月份常有强风，但缆车仍按计划投入运营。
items.whyImportant: 该报道记录了香港重要交通基础设施投入使用时的历史背景与气象挑战。

items.title: Wife of US scholar jailed in China asks Trump to raise arrest at Xi meeting
items.summary: Sylvia Zin is among the family members of people imprisoned in China who are seeking Trump's help when he hosts the country's leader next week.
items.titleZh: 在华被捕美国学者的妻子请求特朗普在会见习近平期间提出此案
items.summaryZh: 随着特朗普即将接待中国领导人，多名在华被监禁人员的家属正寻求其帮助。其中包括被捕美国学者的妻子，她希望特朗普能在双边会晤中提及相关案件。
items.whyImportant: 家属的呼吁将个人案件置于中美外交议程的焦点，增加了双边会谈的复杂性。

items.title: Factsheet series: Hong Kong’s debut 5-year plan and 2026 policy address
items.titleZh: 事实核查系列：香港首个五年计划与2026年政策地址
items.summaryZh: 该系列文章旨在梳理香港首个五年计划的核心内容，并结合2026年政策地址进行分析。内容重点关注政府在未来发展规划中的政策导向。
items.whyImportant: 该系列为公众理解香港政府的长期战略规划与政策重点提供了参考依据。

items.title: Australia news live: Home affairs warns AI enables foreign interference and hackers; BoM updates website to look like ‘old radar view’
items.summary: Follow the day’s news live Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Australia needs to slow down its artificial intelligence use and create better security laws, the companies creating the technology have told the federal government. In a submission to an ongoing inquiry, OpenAI said national leaders had a responsibility to work with other countries to stop global security threats: Many of the most consequential risks will not stop at national borders, making international co-ordination increasingly important. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚新闻直播：内政部警告人工智能助长外国干预与黑客攻击；气象局更新网站恢复“旧雷达视图”
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚联邦政府正面临科技公司建议，要求放缓人工智能应用并完善安全法规。OpenAI在提交的调查报告中指出，人工智能带来的全球安全威胁已超越国界，国际协作至关重要。
items.whyImportant: 此举反映了各国政府在应对人工智能带来的国家安全风险时，正寻求加强监管与国际合作。

items.title: Indonesia gets its first aircraft carrier amid debate over cost and military ambitions
items.summary: The gift from Italy has sparked fierce debate among defence analysts and opposition politicians who question its true cost and purpose Indonesia has received its first aircraft carrier, a former Italian warship that the government says will strengthen the archipelagic nation’s maritime security and disaster response capabilities. The 41-year-old former ITS Giuseppe Garibaldi, with capacity for short takeoff and vertical landing aircraft and helicopters, arrived Friday morning at a naval base in North Jakarta’s Tanjung Priok port, where it was welcomed with a military ceremony. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 印尼接收首艘航空母舰，引发关于成本与军事野心的争论
items.summaryZh: 印度尼西亚接收了一艘由意大利赠送的退役军舰，政府称其将增强海上安全与救灾能力。然而，该舰的实际维护成本及其军事用途在当地引发了国防分析人士和反对派政客的激烈辩论。
items.whyImportant: 这标志着印尼海军力量的扩张，同时也凸显了该国在国防预算分配与战略目标上的内部矛盾。

items.title: Man who sprayed Ilhan Omar with vinegar sentenced to 14 months
items.summary: Anthony Kazmierczak agreed plea deal over January town-hall attack that came amid Minneapolis ICE crackdown The man who sprayed vinegar at the Democratic US House member Ilhan Omar during a Minneapolis town hall was sentenced Thursday to 14 months in prison after reaching a deal with prosecutors. The sentencing of 56-year-old Anthony Kazmierczak came nearly eight months after the 27 January assault. At the time, Minneapolis was facing an immigration crackdown that led to angry protests, arrests and the killing of two US citizens by federal officers. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 向伊尔汗·奥马尔喷洒醋的男子被判入狱14个月
items.summaryZh: 一名56岁男子因在明尼阿波利斯市政厅会议上向美国众议员伊尔汗·奥马尔喷洒醋，与检方达成认罪协议并被判处14个月监禁。该事件发生于当地移民执法引发抗议和骚乱的背景之下。
items.whyImportant: 此判决体现了美国司法系统对针对民选官员袭击行为的惩处力度。

items.title: US to allow Iranian leaders to attend UN meeting in New York amid wartime stand-off
items.summary: The Trump administration has approved visas for top Iranian officials, including the president and foreign minister, to attend next week’s UN General Assembly high-level meeting in New York even as the two countries are locked in a stalemated war. The State Department said Thursday that it had approved visas for Iran’s “core delegation”, along with essential staffers to participate in the UN meetings. The core delegation includes President Masoud Pezeshkian and Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi,...
items.titleZh: 尽管处于战时对峙，美国仍允许伊朗领导人参加纽约联合国会议
items.summaryZh: 尽管美伊两国处于僵持的战争状态，特朗普政府仍批准了伊朗总统及外交部长等核心代表团成员的签证。此举旨在确保伊朗官员能够出席下周在纽约举行的联合国大会高级别会议。
items.whyImportant: 此决定显示了美国在处理敌对国家外交往来时，仍试图维持联合国作为国际对话平台的特殊地位。

items.title: Bank of Japan raises rates to 31-year high of 1.25% as inflation rises
items.summary: Bank of Japan raises benchmark interest rate from 1 to 1.25 percent, pledging to help counter inflation risks.
items.titleZh: 日本央行将利率上调至1.25%，创31年来新高以应对通胀
items.summaryZh: 日本央行宣布将基准利率从1%上调至1.25%。此举旨在通过紧缩货币政策来应对国内日益增长的通胀风险。
items.whyImportant: 日本央行的加息决策标志着其长期超宽松货币政策的进一步转向，对全球金融市场具有重要影响。

items.title: The need for speed as Hong Kong plugs in
items.summary: [The content of this article has been produced by our advertising partner.] Hong Kong is preparing for many more electric vehicles on its roads. The city’s First Five-Year Plan, announced alongside the Policy Address, calls for the steady electrification of vehicles and safe, efficient charging networks, with around 10,000 fast chargers expected by 2035 to support about 500,000 EVs. That longer-term target follows an updated EV roadmap released in February, which calls for fast chargers to...
items.titleZh: 香港加速推进电动汽车充电网络建设
items.summaryZh: 香港正通过首个五年计划推动交通工具电动化，目标是到2035年部署约10,000个快速充电器，以支持约50万辆电动汽车。此举旨在落实最新的电动汽车路线图，确保城市充电网络的安全与高效。
items.whyImportant: 该计划将显著提升香港的电动汽车基础设施，对城市交通绿色转型具有重要意义。

items.title: Like Shenzhen, the Northern Metropolis is animated by the spirit of experimentation
items.summary: At the heart of Hong Kong’s first five-year plan lies the Northern Metropolis – a massive tract of land spanning roughly a third of our entire city. Much ink has been spilled over what this project represents and why it matters, but if I had to summarise it in a single sentence, I would call it the “Shenzhen of Hong Kong”. To me, Shenzhen stands as the most miraculous growth story on Earth. Forty-eight years ago, it was a sleepy fishing village with a single muddy main road and just tens of...
items.titleZh: 北部都会区：以深圳精神驱动的实验性发展
items.summaryZh: 香港首个五年计划的核心在于北部都会区，该项目占地约全市三分之一。作者将其比作“香港的深圳”，强调其作为城市增长引擎的实验性与重要意义。
items.whyImportant: 北部都会区被视为香港未来经济增长与区域融合的关键战略空间。

items.title: New tiger cat species identified in Bolivia, first in over a century
items.summary: New species of wild feline was discovered in Bolivia’s Yungas forest that is smaller than the average domestic ⁠cat A diminutive wild cat that inhabits Bolivia’s ⁠cloud forest has been identified as a previously unknown species, marking the first time a new living feline species has been formally named and described in more than a century. The cat, called tilcayo by local communities, is part of a group called tiger ⁠cats found across much of South ⁠America. It was found in Bolivia’s ​lush Yungas forest, a mountainous region where forests are often covered by clouds and surrounded by high humidity, according to researchers. It measures about 18in (46cm) long and weighs about 3lb (1.4kg), making it smaller than the average domestic ⁠cat. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 玻利维亚发现新虎猫物种，为百年来首次
items.summaryZh: 研究人员在玻利维亚云雾森林中发现了一种名为“tilcayo”的新型野生猫科动物。这是百年来首次正式命名和描述的新猫科物种，其体型比普通家猫还要小。
items.whyImportant: 这一发现丰富了生物多样性记录，并强调了保护云雾森林生态系统的重要性。

items.title: Could this economic squeeze sway US voters?
items.summary: Americans on the lower end of the economy are feeling the impact of higher borrowing costs and weaker purchasing power.
items.titleZh: 这种经济紧缩会影响美国选民吗？
items.summaryZh: 美国低收入群体正承受着借贷成本上升和购买力下降的双重压力。这种经济困境可能对选民的投票倾向产生影响。
items.whyImportant: 经济状况的恶化往往是影响美国大选结果的关键变量。

items.title: Is Trump’s AI obsession walking the world into disaster? – podcast
items.summary: Tech bosses have called for a slowdown in artificial intelligence and the creation of formal guardrails from the US government. But why is President Trump unmoved by the doomsday predictions, dismissing them as a ‘hoax’? What lies behind his embrace of the AI industry? Jonathan Freedland speaks to the Guardian US tech editor, Blake Montgomery Watch Jonathan Freedland on our new Politics Weekly YouTube channel Send your questions and feedback to politicsweeklyamerica@theguardian.com Listen to the latest season of Black Box Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 特朗普对人工智能的痴迷是否正在将世界推向灾难？
items.summaryZh: 尽管科技界领袖呼吁对人工智能进行监管并设立护栏，但特朗普总统对此持怀疑态度，并将其斥为骗局。外界关注他为何如此坚定地支持人工智能产业发展。
items.whyImportant: 美国政府对人工智能的监管态度将直接影响全球科技发展的方向与安全风险。

items.title: Rare honour: Trump will greet Xi at Joint Base Andrews, not just White House
items.summary: US President Donald Trump will personally greet Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping on the tarmac at Joint Base Andrews when Xi lands in Washington next Wednesday, a rare airport reception, a US official confirmed on background. Trump will attend Xi’s arrival ceremony at Andrews, where the Chinese president’s aircraft is expected around 4pm local time on September 23. The president almost never meets visiting heads of state at the airfield. He typically waits at the White House. The gesture is not a...
items.titleZh: 罕见礼遇：特朗普将在安德鲁斯联合基地迎接习近平，而非仅在白宫会面
items.summaryZh: 美国官员证实，特朗普总统将于下周三亲自前往安德鲁斯联合基地迎接中国国家主席习近平。这种在机场直接迎接外国元首的做法在美国外交中极为罕见。
items.whyImportant: 这一高规格的接待安排显示了美中两国在外交礼仪上的特殊考量，可能预示着双方关系的微妙变化。

items.title: RFK Jr promises anti-vaxxers a ‘friend at the White House’ amid deadly measles outbreak
items.summary: The US health secretary added that he would’ve made sweeping changes ‘on day one’ but he had to follow the law As the death toll from the worst measles outbreak in decades rises, Robert F Kennedy Jr headlined the Washington DC conference of the anti-vaccine organization Children’s Health Defense, which he led for nearly a decade. “Let me be clear. You have a strong and steadfast friend at the White House,” Kennedy, now serving as secretary of the US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), told anti-vaccine activists at the conference in a nearly hour-and-a-half-long speech. He urged patience, saying that he would’ve made sweeping changes “on day one” but that he had to follow the law in order to make permanent change. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 小罗伯特·肯尼迪在麻疹疫情期间承诺为反疫苗人士提供“白宫盟友”
items.summaryZh: 现任美国卫生与公众服务部部长的小罗伯特·肯尼迪在反疫苗组织会议上表示，他将是该群体的坚定盟友。尽管他承诺进行改革，但也强调必须依法行事以实现长期变革。
items.whyImportant: 作为卫生部门最高官员，其反疫苗立场引发了公众对公共卫生政策走向的担忧。

items.title: Poland eyes deeper Philippines defence ties following Black Hawk deal
items.summary: Poland’s delivery of Black Hawk helicopters to the Philippines has given Warsaw a foothold in Manila’s defence market as it seeks to expand exports from its growing defence industry, with analysts saying drones, air defence and potentially co-production could pave the way for a broader partnership. Polish deputy foreign minister Wladyslaw Bartoszewski said on Tuesday that Warsaw was keen to pursue further defence partnerships with the Philippines, as Poland poured US$50 billion into...
items.titleZh: 继黑鹰直升机交易后，波兰寻求深化与菲律宾的防务关系
items.summaryZh: 波兰通过向菲律宾交付黑鹰直升机成功进入当地防务市场。波兰政府表示希望在无人机和防空系统等领域进一步扩大合作。
items.whyImportant: 波兰正积极拓展其国防工业出口，此举反映了其在全球防务市场中影响力的提升。

items.title: Amid claims of ‘mass migration’, Labor hopes a measured approach will take the hot air out of the debate
items.summary: The country’s migration settings have become a source of discontent – but will Tony Burke’s approach be seen as the right mix? Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Tony Burke has promised to make Labor’s existing migration policy work better rather than announcing a dramatic cut in numbers, arguing that populist promises to slash net overseas migration will “trash Australian services and trash the Australian economy”. The home affairs minister’s message was immediately endorsed by employer groups, who over recent days have made it clear that steps to arbitrarily slash migrant numbers would compound already severe skills shortages and hurt businesses, especially those in the regions. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 在“大规模移民”的争议声中，工党希望通过审慎的政策平息辩论
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚内政部长托尼·伯克承诺优化现有移民政策，而非采取激进的削减措施。雇主团体支持这一立场，认为大幅削减移民将加剧技能短缺并损害经济。
items.whyImportant: 移民政策的调整是澳大利亚当前政治辩论的核心，直接关系到劳动力市场和经济稳定。

items.title: Italy to deploy warships to protect shipping through Bab al-Mandeb
items.summary: Italy's defence minister warns of severe economic fallout if Bab al-Mandeb becomes impassable, bypassing EU delays.
items.titleZh: 意大利将部署军舰保护曼德海峡的航运安全
items.summaryZh: 意大利国防部长警告称，如果曼德海峡无法通行，将对经济造成严重后果。意大利决定绕过欧盟的决策延迟，采取独立行动保护航运。
items.whyImportant: 此举凸显了关键海上贸易通道安全对欧洲经济的重要性，以及各国在应对地缘政治风险时的自主行动。
